coverage: All 32 story pages and both covers reviewed as rendered pages; named critical identity/text pages examined at enlarged scale. Automated tests cover geometry/source selection only.

identity_locks.Roshan: Brown hair with rainbow section; gold/blue crown; pink ruffled short sleeves; blue waist trim; lavender iridescent tail with rainbow fin. No long-sleeve substitution.
identity_locks.Daddy: Long olive-brown hair; glasses; gold crown; navy embroidered jacket and teal cape; rainbow-scaled tail.
identity_locks.Rumi: Purple long braid and raised front curl; embroidered purple/navy jacket; turquoise-to-pink tail.
identity_locks.Baby Eagle: Pink crest; pale beak base and black tip; pastel blue/mint body with yellow cheek patches; pink/black wings; long smooth grey legs and rounded grey feet. No black talons.
identity_locks.Rainbow friend: Broad spiral ears, large pink forehead curl, four-point sparkle, pearl details, scalloped rainbow body, no legs/paws.
